title: Greeicy, Jay Wheeler, Kany García, Rawayana, Ryan Castro, Trueno & More Set for Billboard Latin Music Week 2026
summary: Registration is now open for the Oct. 19-22 event at Faena Forum Miami Beach.
contentText:
Billboard announced Wednesday (July 21) the first round of speakers confirmed for 2026 Billboard Latin Music Week , taking place at the Faena Forum Miami Beach this October.

Among the star-studded names are Greeicy , Jay Wheeler , Jessi Uribe , Kany García , Lola Índigo , Paola Jara , RaiNao , Rawayana , Ryan Castro , Trueno and Zhamira , with more talent to be announced in the coming weeks. Executive panelists include Nat Pastor, Tommy Mottola and Victor Gonzalez, alongside additional industry leaders still to be revealed.

“Latin music is a global powerhouse, listened to more than ever around the world, and that is thanks to its extraordinary artists and executives,” Leila Cobo, Billboard ‘s co-chief content officer, said in a statement. “ Billboard has been part of this journey, and we are proud to once again bring top talent to Billboard Latin Music Week in Miami, where the industry comes together to celebrate its achievements and help shape its future.”

Taking place Oct. 19 to 22, Billboard Latin Music Week is recognized as the longest-running, highest-profile and most influential gathering in Latin music. This year’s edition, themed “Global Consolidation,” will once again spotlight the genre’s continued worldwide expansion with multiple days of performances, exclusive conversations, panels, workshops, showcases, networking and fan experiences.

Billboard CEO Mike Van added: “For more than three decades, Billboard Latin Music Week has stood as the premier global celebration of Latin music. We’re honored to welcome this year’s talent as we continue inspiring conversations that move the industry forward.”

Last year’s sold-out edition featured appearances by Anuel AA, Carín León, Carlos Vives, Codiciado, Daddy Yankee, Danny Ocean, DJ Khaled, Gloria & Emilio Estefan, Emilia, Ivy Queen, Kali Uchis, Laura Pausini, Myke Towers, Oscar Maydon, Ozuna, Tokischa and Xavi among others.

Billboard Latin Music Week 2026 will also coincide with the 2026 Billboard Latin Music Awards , taking place Oct. 22 in Miami and broadcasting live on Telemundo and Peacock. For more information on Billboard Latin Music Week and ticket sales, visit  BillboardLatinMusicWeek.com .
